video_title: Cavs Practice | Donovan Mitchell Media Availability | 10.16.2026

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland's growth and maturity in his third season
quotes.excerpt: I think there's more of a maturity. I think understanding that, okay, what worked for me?
quotes.quote: I think there's more of a maturity. I think understanding that, okay, what worked for me? How can I get guys open? How can I, you know, we had a play today that he wouldn't have made the beginning of last year where I'm on an isolation, he's coming up to set a flare screen, he slips right to the rim and gets himself an easy layup. That's how he can still be efficient, that's how he can free the defense and play behind the defense, and then also be high-level with his role. So him thinking the game has gotten to another level.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell says Darius Garland has reached a new level of maturity this season, specifically noting his improved decision making and ability to read the game during team practice.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland's leadership and accountability during team practice
quotes.excerpt: Him speaking in practice, trying to hold guys accountable, has been huge.
quotes.quote: Him speaking in practice, trying to hold guys accountable, has been huge. Him and I constantly talk. If I'm ever tired, he's always talking to me, vice versa. So I think there's a level of maturity, there's a level of confidence too, in understanding that when you're in a system and you've played in playoff games, you've played in important games on the season, you've been the leading scorer in a game, you've been in last minutes, he's played every role. And I think now coming into it, he has a better understanding of what he needs to do and what he needs for us, what we need from him to to be better.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell highlights the leadership growth of Darius Garland, noting that Garland is now holding teammates accountable and communicating more during practice sessions.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Supporting teammates through difficult playoff experiences
quotes.excerpt: I told him it's like, listen, it happens to everybody.
quotes.quote: I told him it's like, listen, it happens to everybody. Look at Peyton Watson, right? Peyton came in and he's not the Peyton Watson he was when he first got to the league. Him and Michael Malone both spoke on the examples of being held accountable on the film room. His spot, Darius is different because you come from, you know, in the scoring 40 points in a game, it's not necessarily playing well, then you be to kind of make a few mistakes. And I said, listen, that's all part of the process. That's all part of the growth. All you can do is get better from it. If you want to harp on it, then you don't grow, you don't elevate.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell on helping teammates navigate tough playoff losses: It is all part of the process and growth. If you want to harp on mistakes, you do not grow or elevate.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Developing chemistry between Evan Mobley and James
quotes.excerpt: I think Evan and James can really have a really strong connection.
quotes.quote: I think Evan and James can really have a really strong connection. I think Jay and I have a really great, really good connection in our team and game as well. We were one of the best pick-and-roll duos and I think James and Evan can be the exact same thing in a different look. I think that's something that Kenny, Evan, James, and myself, we all kind of said, all right, listen, there's no works on it and I think it's really going to be beneficial for everybody.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell believes the pick and roll chemistry between Evan Mobley and James will be a major asset for the Cavs this season, offering a different dynamic than what Mobley has had previously.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley's potential as a pick-and-roll partner
quotes.excerpt: I think James is one of, if not the best pick-and-roll handler with big.
quotes.quote: I think James is one of, if not the best pick-and-roll handler with big. And I think for Evan to be able to play with Darius, myself, and now James, to be able to have three different types of pick-and-roll handlers playing with him, I think being able to grab, grab different things and also being put in positions to, you know, get easy buckets, you know. James is a better lob thrower than I am, I'm more of a pocket guy, right? So like Evan's a pocket guy too. Now Evan's going to work on rolling. Evan wants to pop back, James can play the pick-and-pop big. So I think Evan will be able to see a different dynamic than what he's seeing with myself.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell breaks down the tactical advantage of Evan Mobley playing with different handlers, noting that James is a better lob thrower while he prefers the pocket pass.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Dismissing external GM surveys and player rankings
quotes.excerpt: I don't buy into that, like in those things it's up for opinion, it's up for debate.
quotes.quote: I don't buy into that, like in those things it's up for opinion, it's up for debate. That's why it's why it's put out there. Is Luka a small forward to you? He's one of the best point guards we have in this league. You know what I'm saying? So like, who are we to sit here and be like, oh man, such and such, this GM didn't say that, well Kobe thinks that. I think that. Like so all that matters is what we think. It doesn't matter what the GM of the Spurs or the GM of the Thunder or the Heat or the I think at the end of the day, we believe in us, Evan believes in us, and at the end of the day, that's all that really matters.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell is brushing off external GM surveys and player rankings: It does not matter what the GM of the Spurs or the Thunder thinks. All that matters is what we believe in us.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Addressing the narrative that Evan Mobley's development has plateaued
quotes.excerpt: Everyone talks about the fact that Darius and I were being hounded and Evan was the one.
quotes.quote: Everyone talks about the fact that Darius and I were being hounded and Evan was the one that was stepping up for that game. It's like that never happened. Like, you know what I mean? It's like game, what was the game six at the Detroit, game five at the Detroit, we don't speak about that. We've been down three, like you know what I mean? Like we two. We don't, it's like we dismiss his successes and hard to focus on the little things, right? And I think some of it is unfair, but hey, like top five pick is what comes with it. And at the end of the day, he's just going to put his head down and do what he's got to do.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell defends Evan Mobley against narratives that his development has plateaued, calling the criticism unfair and noting that people often dismiss his past successes in big games.
